### [Access to healthcare among Medicare beneficiaries](Master_Thesis.qmd)

<div class="meta"><span>Master in Management · ESCP Business School</span><span>Jérôme Creel</span><span>2024</span><span class="grade">Grade: 18/20</span></div>

My earlier master's thesis studies ethnic and socioeconomic differences in access to medication and service use. It uses the 2013 and 2020 Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey public-use files, chi-square tests, and multivariable logistic regressions, accounting for demographics, education, health, and insurance coverage.

[Paper & presentation →](Master_Thesis.qmd) · [Code on GitHub ↗](https://github.com/Rfernex/Personal-Projects/tree/main/Master%20thesis%20ESCP)

:::
